issues.what: once the whole body is in frame the camera locks off. Eleven contact frames across about 28 s are identical, so place 7 plays as a 28 s still. That makes it the longest beat in the film and stretches the runtime to 3:17
issues.fix: keep the hold to about 6 to 8 s with a slow continuing drift or rotation, then end. Trim so the whole film comes in near 3:00

issues.what: the rise from the lake to orbit does not play as one move. The camera goes from just above the water (9315) to near-black space with only a thin limb (9428) in under 2 s. Then it holds on empty navy for about 5 s across the place boundary, so it reads as a fade to black and a new shot, not a continuous climb. The body then appears close up (9752) before the pull-out
issues.fix: make it one unbroken ascent of about 8 to 10 s: lake, then crater, then the land outline, then the limb, keeping ground in frame the whole way. Cut the empty navy frames, and let the camera arrive at the full-body framing as the last part of that same move

issues.what: a large pale blob passes right in front of the lens and blocks half to two-thirds of the frame, so it plays as a wipe
issues.fix: move the camera path or the foreground object so it passes at the edge of frame, or remove it

issues.what: after the push toward the cave, the camera jumps within about 2 s to grazing the rock face (7367), then swings back toward the cave (7601), then to another face-on angle (7718). The path reads as a chain of separate views, not one travel through the place
issues.fix: run a single continuous spline: push along the ridge past the streamers, then into the cave mouth, with no reversals

issues.what: inside the tunnel the camera faces out, and the opening shrinks as it backs away. The peak that should hold the cave is visible through the mouth, so the geography breaks, and the push-in plays as a pull-back
issues.fix: keep the camera facing its direction of travel into the cave, or frame the mouth so the outside view is consistent with the cave being in that peak

issues.where: whole frame, opening wide of place 6
issues.what: the camera sits higher and farther back than in the target. The lake fills only about the middle 65% of the width instead of nearly all of it, a grey foreground rim takes the bottom third, and the herd at the shoreline is too small to read. The target is shot low from the shore with the herd across the lower middle
issues.fix: lower the camera and bring it to the shore so the lake spans the frame and the herd sits in the lower third

issues.what: the camera drops from the rim to ground level on the flats in about 2 s, then rolls to a tilted horizon (8754). The fast drop and the roll read as a cut
issues.fix: make the descent a slower glide over 4 to 5 s and keep the horizon level, or add roll only as a gentle banked turn

issues.what: near the animals the camera hardly moves for about 4 s
issues.fix: keep a slow lateral track past the herd
